data.long_description:
Welcome to this beautifully maintained villa in the heart of Springs 12, one of Dubai’s most sought-after family communities. Offering a perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and natural beauty, this home is ideal for those seeking peaceful suburban living with easy access to city essentials.

Situated within a secure, gated community, this property is just steps away from scenic lakes, lush parks, and walking trails. Residents of Springs 12 enjoy access to multiple communal swimming pools, children’s play areas, and sports courts, including tennis and basketball facilities.

Additional amenities include:

• Fully equipped gym and fitness center
• Outdoor BBQ and picnic areas
• Nearby Spinney’s supermarket, pharmacy, cafes, and restaurants
• Pet-friendly environment with dog park access
• Peaceful surroundings with 24/7 security and landscaped greenery

Whether you're a family, couple, or investor, Springs 12 offers a vibrant yet tranquil lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most established communities.

Company: Provident Real Estate
